posts.text: Alex Highsmith on shutting down Jonathan Taylor: “I think what really helped was understanding that when he gets going, he's the engine of their offense. For us, it was about playing a physical game up front, getting off blocks, and doing a good job of slowing him down. We still have some things to clean up in other areas defensively, but overall, I thought we played a physical brand of football. It was a complementary effort. The pass rush and coverage worked together, especially late in the game. I'm grateful for this group and the way we played together.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: Chris Hoke thinks Aaron Rodgers is playing as good as he’s played in years: “I think Aaron Rodgers is playing as good as he’s played in several years. You look at how he’s moving in the pocket and how he’s throwing the ball and not putting the ball in harm’s way. With three touchdowns a game the last three games I think he’s playing as one of the better quarterbacks in the NFL to date. He extended plays over and over again and I knew he was on his game and felt good [when] he was over there chirping and talking some trash with the Colts’ defensive coordinator between plays.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: With Ashton Jeanty questionable because of foot and ankle injuries, the Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.

posts.text:
The Cardinals have fielded calls for the last few weeks centered around Marvin Harrison Jr. Now, per me and Adam Schefter, he'll be inactive this week as his tenure in AZ is over.

No trade is finalized as of now. But he's expected to be traded.

Chargers OT Rashawn Slater underwent successful ankle surgery yesterday in LA, a tightrope procedure aimed at accelerating his return from a high ankle sprain.

Slater, who was injured in Sunday’s game vs the Seahawks, will be placed on Injured Reserve and begin rehabbing.

Bad news: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr aggravated his foot injury, and coach Mike McCarthy said he'll miss multiple weeks. Pittman had been dealing with plantar fasciitis.

posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”
